tools.name: check_page_seo
tools.title: Check one page for SEO problems
tools.description: Reads one web page and its robots.txt and reports a score out of 100, problems by area (crawling and indexing, security, search listing, page basics, AI search, structured data, sharing) and the most serious problem with its fix.

url.description: The page address, for example example.com/pricing/. https:// is assumed if left out.

annotations.title: Check one page for SEO problems

tools.name: check_ai_crawlers
tools.title: Check which AI crawlers robots.txt allows
tools.description: Reads a site's robots.txt and says, for each AI crawler (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Apple, Meta, Parallel and others), whether it may fetch the given path and which rule decides.

url.description: The page address, for example example.com/pricing/. https:// is assumed if left out.

annotations.title: Check which AI crawlers robots.txt allows

tools.name: trace_redirects
tools.title: Trace a redirect chain
tools.description: Follows an address one hop at a time and lists each hop with its HTTP status code and destination, then flags loops, chains of two or more redirects, temporary redirects and pages left on plain http.

url.description: The page address, for example example.com/pricing/. https:// is assumed if left out.

tools.name: check_http_headers
tools.title: Check a page’s HTTP response headers
tools.description: Returns the final status code and the response headers that matter for search and security (X-Robots-Tag, Cache-Control, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and others), with a verdict on each.

url.description: The page address, for example example.com/pricing/. https:// is assumed if left out.

annotations.title: Check a page’s HTTP response headers

tools.name: preview_search_snippet
tools.title: Preview a search result title and description
tools.description: Measures a title and meta description and shows where a search result would cut each off. Fetches nothing.

annotations.title: Preview a search result title and description

calls.name: trace_redirects
calls.text:
1. http://docketseo.app/ -> HTTP 301 -> https://docketseo.app/
2. https://docketseo.app/ -> HTTP 200 (the page)
Fine: One redirect. http://docketseo.app/ sends visitors to https://docketseo.app/ in one step.
Fine: http:// is sent to HTTPS

calls.name: check_http_headers
calls.text:
HTTP 200 from https://docketseo.app/.
content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8
cache-control: max-age=14400
last-modified: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 04:40:14 GMT
vary: Accept-Encoding
server: cloudflare
age: 0
Fine: No HSTS header needed: .app is HTTPS-only in every major browser. The whole .app domain is on the HSTS preload list built into the browsers, so a first visit is never made over http://.
Note: Missing 2 baseline security headers. Not set: x-content-type-options, referrer-policy. Low-risk to add at the server or CDN. Referrer-Policy can also be set with a meta tag in the page, which this check does not read.
